M2-type antimitochondrial and anti-21-ß-hydroxylase antibodies were present with no signs of biliary cirrhosis or adrenal insufficiency. Despite elevated anti-GAD antibody titers no diabetes mellitus was present. Authors argue SPS appears unrelated to breast cancer (nonparaneoplastic origin).
